resources.string: Compares the text of the two latest explicit saves on this device. Dates are save times, not publication dates. No server receives this comparison. Formatting and images are not compared.
Save this public article offline again to compare two versions. Articles saved before this feature need one new save.
Partial comparison: limited to the first 8,000 characters and 200 paragraphs of each version. Changes after that limit are not shown.
No text changes within the compared portion. Whitespace differences are ignored.
